text:
Mannheim’s median asking rent sits at 12.54 €/m² in June 2026, up 3.8 % year‑on‑year and 21.2 % over the past five years, placing the city 15th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 50 %, with a typical 60 m² apartment costing about 752 € per month.

The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 1.8 % and listings staying on the market for an average of 28 days; 27 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 16.8 %, reflecting limited affordability despite modest population growth of 2.4 % over five years.

The model‑based forecast expects median asking rents to reach 13.08 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 12.76 €/m² and 13.44 €/m², indicating a further 4.3 % rise.
